articles.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
articles.description: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
articles.description: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
articles.description: As AI becomes harder to avoid, consumers are growing more wary of the technology — and Silicon Valley is discovering that widespread adoption doesn’t necessarily lead to acceptance.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
articles.description: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
articles.description: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users
articles.description: Affected users told TechCrunch they were using Grok Lite, and noticed the issues as early as Wednesday morning.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT launched were written by AI, study finds
articles.description: ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of the new web.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
articles.description: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
articles.description: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
articles.description: Anthropic forbids its Claude models from generating sexually explicit content. But a series of tests conducted by TechCrunch found that it didn't take much to get past the restriction.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan
